summary: Propagates a new scale value to scene-graph children when it changes (thiscall). Computes the scale ratio old->new and applies velocity scaling on the primary child node, and on a secondary child node when present. Per-frame tick on the vehicle transform/scale path.

operations.description: Guard on scale change: a2 != *(float *)(this + 0x970); when the new scale equals the current stored scale the whole update is skipped.
Compute the scale ratio v4 = a2 / *(float *)(this + 0x970) from the pre-update scale value, staged through local float v6.
SceneGraphChildVelocityScaling(*(_DWORD *)(this + 4), v6, 0) applies the ratio to the primary scene-graph child node.
Load secondary child pointer v5 = *(_DWORD *)(*(_DWORD *)(this + 4) + 0x44); when non-zero, SceneGraphChildVelocityScaling(v5, v6, 1) applies the ratio to it as a second child.
Called by VehicleRespawnReset (0x004E0800) and sub_4F0D20 (0x004F0D20) to re-propagate a vehicle scale change.

unresolved: Semantic units of the scale value at this+0x970 (visual scale factor) and the meaning of the two child-node velocity scalings.
The object owning `this` and the two scene-graph child nodes is unknown (UnknownObject).
